100 jaar De Stijl placeholder page

A one-screen holding page for the 2017 centenary whose logo spells “100 JAAR DE STIJL” in square-built letters in red, yellow, blue, gray, and black.

This is an archived copy. The page says the site was still in development, and it links to an official national website elsewhere.

Observed

  • The page is white with centered small text: “deze site is in ontwikkeling” and the dates “1917 - 2017”.
  • The logo spells “100 JAAR” and “DE STIJL” in letters built from square strokes and right angles; the numerals are red, yellow, and blue, the other letters gray and black.
  • Below are an e-mail link, three black social icons, and a footer between two thin gray rules that credits Manschot Grafimedia, Zeist.

Why it belongs

The logo is the only part in the style, and it is an image, so the measurement sees only the centered Gill Sans text (1 hue, no borders).

Borrow

Build a wordmark from square strokes on a grid, and color only a few letters with the primaries.
